I have a Bachelor and Master level professional degree in translation and interpretation.
My teaching experience is about 5 years – in private, in groups up to 20 people and online. 
I have various experience, but personally prefer helping beginners and intermediate language users to improve their skills, especially speaking, in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere.

- Conversational practice and role-play

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are very customized and goal-oriented. I'm very patient and try to explain everything thoroughly. I also help to understand situational and cultural context. Students set the pace and the topics, which are of biggest interest to them.
We mainly learn new words and phrases a student can use right away in real life. On a more advanced level we have conversations about different topics, read literature, use audio and video materials. If you want to follow a textbook - we can do that as well. But if you prefer the lessons to be more relaxed and fun, I can offer different games, role-play and other fun activities. 
I can help you with your homework or any other language related tasks.

pro_course_detail.title: Discovering Lesotho as a country (culture, food, language and many more)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this 60-minute lesson, students will explore Lesotho’s geography, language, traditions, and daily life while enhancing their English skills in listening, speaking, and comprehension. Through interactive discussions, role-playing, and multimedia resources, they will develop a deeper understanding of the country’s unique cultural identity.
Introduction to Lesotho:
Students will begin by identifying Lesotho on a map and learning about its location, capital city (Maseru), and mountainous landscape. They will explore why Lesotho is known as the "Kingdom in the Sky" and discuss how geography influences daily life.
Basic Sesotho Phrases
Students will be introduced to essential Sesotho greetings and expressions such as:

Dumelang! (Hello)
O kae? (How are you?)
Kea leboha! (Thank you)
Daily Life and Traditions
Students will examine key aspects of life in Lesotho, including traditional clothing like the Basotho blanket and Mokorotlo hat. They will learn about common foods such as papa (maize porridge) and moroho (leafy greens) and discuss how people navigate the mountainous terrain, often using horses.
Reflection and Speaking Practice
To conclude the lesson, students will participate in a reflective discussion about Lesotho’s culture and traditions. They will articulate their thoughts through spoken or written responses, summarizing key takeaways from the lesson. Depending on their language proficiency level, students will either write a short paragraph or present their insights orally. we will also be discussing their culture and country of origin. Lets have fun learning!

pro_course_detail.title: Mastering Polite English: Essential Skills for Everyday Conversations
pro_course_detail.description:
1. Introductions & Icebreaker (10 minutes)
The session kicks off with a casual exchange of introductions, where both tutor and student share a little about themselves, their interests, and experiences with English. This not only creates a relaxed atmosphere but also sets the tone for an engaging conversation. To keep things interesting, an open-ended question is posed: If you could have a chat with any historical or famous figure, who would you choose and why? This helps the student practice expressing opinions while keeping the conversation natural and interactive.
2. The Role of Politeness in Communication (10 minutes)
Next, the discussion shifts to the significance of politeness in different cultures and how it influences communication. The student is encouraged to reflect on past experiences and consider moments where a conversation may have come across as too direct or even impolite. A guiding question like Have you ever had a situation where someone seemed rude but may not have intended to be? invites the student to share insights, laying the groundwork for a deeper understanding of how politeness shapes conversations.
3. Recognizing Politeness: Direct vs. Indirect Speech (15 minutes)
This section introduces a comparison of direct and indirect speech, helping the student grasp how tone and phrasing impact social interactions. By examining examples such as Give me your phone versus Could you pass me your phone, please?, the student learns the subtle yet crucial differences that make a conversation sound more considerate. Key polite expressions are introduced, including phrases for making requests (Would you be able to…?, I was wondering if…), expressing opinions gently (I see what you mean, but…), and disagreeing politely (I understand your perspective, but…). The goal is to equip the student with adaptable tools for handling various situations with tact and diplomacy.
4. Hands-On Practice: Rewording for Politeness (10 minutes) and many more.

pro_course_detail.title: Metaphor: fall on stony ground
pro_course_detail.description:
[0:00 - 5:00] Introduction:
Hello, welcome to today’s lesson! In this class, we’re going to explore an interesting and important phrase: “fall on stony ground.” This phrase is often used in English to describe something that doesn’t have the impact or effect that was expected. It refers to an idea, a suggestion, a plea, or an action that doesn’t get the attention or response it deserves, almost as if it fell on the hard, unyielding surface of stony ground, where it can’t grow or take root. By the end of the lesson, you’ll not only understand what "fall on stony ground" means but also be able to use it in different contexts and recognize situations where it might apply. We’ll go over some important vocabulary related to this phrase, analyze a passage, discuss situations where this might happen, and practice using it through conversation and role-play. This is going to be a very engaging lesson, and I’m excited to have you explore this concept with me!
[5:00 - 15:00] Vocabulary and Meaning:
To start, let’s dive into the meaning behind “fall on stony ground.” This metaphor originates from the idea of seeds being planted in soil. When seeds are planted in good, fertile soil, they can grow and develop. However, if the seeds fall on stony ground, they won’t be able to take root and grow. It’s the same for ideas or efforts: sometimes, no matter how hard we try or how important something is, it doesn’t get the response we hope for, and it seems like our efforts were wasted, just like the seed on stony ground. For example, imagine you have an idea that you are very passionate about, but when you present it to a group, they don’t seem to care or respond positively. This is a situation where your idea has "fallen on stony ground."
In the next part of the lesson, we’ll learn some vocabulary related to this phrase, which will help us understand it better and use it more effectively.
[15:00 - 25:00] Key Vocabulary:
We’ll now go over some vocabulary words that will help us.

pro_course_detail.title: The art of saying Hello in English
pro_course_detail.description:
[0:00 - 5:00] Introduction to Greetings
We’ll begin by discussing the importance of greetings in everyday life. I will ask you a few questions to engage you right from the start. For example: “How do you greet people in your language?” “What is the first thing you say when you meet someone?” This will get the conversation going and set the tone for the lesson.
Then, I will introduce the main goal of today’s class: learning the different ways to say “hello” in English, depending on the time of day, the situation, and the person you're talking to.
[5:00 - 15:00] Vocabulary and Common Greetings
At this stage, we’ll dive into the key vocabulary related to greetings. I will present and explain different greetings commonly used in English, including:

"Hello" – The most common and neutral greeting. You can use this with anyone, in any situation, no matter the time of day.
"Hi" – A more casual version of “hello,” often used with friends, family, and people you know well.
"Good morning" – A polite greeting used in the morning, typically before noon.
"Good afternoon" – A greeting used from midday until the evening (usually after 12:00 pm).
"Good evening" – A greeting used in the evening, after around 5:00 pm.
"How are you?" – A common follow-up to a greeting, especially in more casual conversations.
"Hey" – A very informal greeting, typically used among friends and people you’re close to.
"What's up?" – A very casual and informal way of greeting, often used between close friends, with the implied question, "How are you?"
"Yo!" – A slang greeting, often used among young people in casual settings.
"Hi there" – A friendly, informal greeting.
We will go through each greeting, its pronunciation, and when to use it. I will also clarify any cultural or regional differences in greetings, as they can vary from one English-speaking country to another.
[15:00 - 30:00] The Context of Greetings and Cultural Importance
[30:00 - 45:00] Practice with Dialogues
[45:00 - 55:00] Pronunciation

pro_course_detail.title: Building Bridges: Mastering Friendships at Work, Home, and Beyond
pro_course_detail.description:
In this 60-minute 1-on-1 lesson, we’ll focus on how to build and maintain strong friendships in various areas of life, whether at work, at home, or within your social circle. This lesson is designed for all levels, from A1 to C2, offering personalized content that will help you improve communication and social skills for better relationships.

Lesson Breakdown:

0:00 - 5:00 | Introduction and Goal Setting
We’ll begin by discussing your specific goals for the lesson. Whether you're looking to improve workplace communication, strengthen personal connections, or navigate difficult social situations, we’ll set a clear focus for our time together.

5:00 - 15:00 | Vocabulary and Key Phrases
You’ll learn important vocabulary and phrases for discussing friendships:

For A1 learners: Basic words like "friend," "trust," and "help."
For higher levels (B1-C2): More advanced expressions like "emotional support," "conflict resolution," and "building rapport."
We’ll practice using these words in context through simple exercises tailored to your level.
15:00 - 30:00 | Friendships in the Workplace
This segment will focus on how to navigate relationships at work, including:

Making friends while maintaining professionalism.
Effective communication in teams and managing workplace conflicts.
Through role-play, you’ll practice realistic scenarios, improving your confidence in professional settings.
30:00 - 45:00 | Friendships at Home and with Friends
We’ll explore maintaining personal relationships, covering topics like:

Open communication with family and friends.
Resolving conflicts and offering support.
You’ll practice discussing these topics and learn strategies to manage personal relationships effectively.
45:00 - 60:00 | Review & Personalized Advice
We’ll review what you’ve learned, provide feedback, and discuss how to apply these skills in real life. You'll also have the chance to ask questions and get personalized advice.

teacher_info.intro: Hello, My name is Mpho. I am a 28 years old lady from the beautiful country in the Southern part of Africa called Lesotho, also known as the Mountain Kingdom. I also have a 120 hours TEFL Certificate which has played a huge role in ensuring that I assume my role as a tutor well because this certificate has opened me to different cultures and traditions, how people behave, and how I am supposed to handle each and everyone of them in respect to their beliefs. Communication is one of my strongest points and enrolling in Public Relations played a part too, because I was taught on how to approach different people in different circumstances.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have exceptional communication skills and I am very patient but at the same time, I ensure that I enforce the right mentality so that my students may learn and reach their different goals. I believe in tailoring my lessons to the specific needs of my students so that I deliver the relevant information to my students. I use different teaching styles for different learners such as teacher-based learning where I  give information to the students then test their understanding using quizzes and comprehension questions, student-based learning where I follow on where the students' interest lies, and hands on teaching which includes making experiments together with the student so that they learn through participating.

teaching_experience.description: I have taught online to different nationalities such as Japanese, Taiwanese and South Korenas for a period of a six months and I have gotten the privilege of teaching different age groups from the ages of 7 and above who were beginners, intermediate, and advanced level learners. I used a student centered learning for adults and a teacher based learning for children to ensure that I give them information and let them engage to ensure that they understand and are comfortable with the lessons.

course_info.trial_description: Hello, I am very pleased to meet you. I am Mpho and I would love to offer a helping hand as far as your expectations are concerned in learning the English language. My lessons offer a variety of topics such as conversational English, English for beginners, and they are determined by my students interests because at the end of the day, the whole point of offering guidance in English, is ensuring that you are well equipped to hold conversations in English, read or write in the most effective way for you. For instances where learners require a much structured lessons, I use material such as textbooks and articles and for learners who prefer having conversations to build on their confidence, I allow you to speak then show you the correct grammatical way, of talking without making you feel less of yourself.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Everyday Life
pro_course_detail.description: Hello, I offer lessons for beginners who have very limited experince as far as the English language is concerned and we look at different phrases which are used on an everyday basis while communicating in English. I help such students by helping them know the right way to articule and the right grammar such as the Subject verb agreement. In this lesson I use tools such as articles and texbooks to look at the words, phrases, or sentences which we will be learning. Whether in speaking or reading, my lessons will help you grow confident and will impart knowlegde so that you are able to hold conversations which have the correct grammatical rules. I use the student centered inquiry where I will allow you to put thought into our lessons and use critical thinking as you try to recall everything which we have talked abour or learned together. This lessons are also for people who have an idea of the English language and the purpose of this lessons for them is to help them grow to becoming fluent English users in speaking, writing and reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar secrets: Learn the Rules of English in a Simple way
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is mainly for students who would love to work on the English grammar and excel in speaking and writing English using correct grammar.  Grammar is one of the most important rules in Emglish because it is the core of English therefore, anyone who wants to improve must delve into grammar. My lessons are very flexible and easy going even for complete beginners, in this lesson, I believe that we learn from our mistakes but they do not define us, and that is why I allow my students to make mistakes so that they can learn from there. From being able to give a full introduction of who we are, to being able to make presentations either in school or at work, my lessons will ensure that you are comfortable enough to create the presentation and execute it by having the confidence to present it in a confident way.

pro_course_detail.title: Master English Pronunciation: Speak Fluently in no Time
pro_course_detail.description: Wthether you are struggling to pronounce certain sounds, or you just want to improve the clarity of your speech, I am here to help. My English pronunciation lessons are designed to help you identify and correct common pronunciation mistakes, and to develop the muscle memory you need to speak English more naturally and fluently. We will work together to improve your pronunciation through a variety of exercises from tongue-twisters to role-playing. I believe that learning English pronunciation should be fun and engaging, and I will use a variety of resources to help you achieve your goals. You will learn through listening, repeating, and receiving feedback. I am passionate about heping students with their different English needs and I am more than happy to help you meet your goals as I have helped a number of students too.

pro_course_detail.title: Let us read together
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson plan is designed for students who have an interest in acquiring the reading skill in English. In this lesson, I create different stories for different levels as well as well as different ages, we read and answer questions in relations to the story we may have read. The purpose of this lesson is to ensure that we are a fluent reader and can attempt to read anything in English. It is furthermore, designed to assist on articualtion as well as the correct pronunciation of the English words.

pro_course_detail.title: General group lessons
pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson I offer general tailored English leaners for students who would love to learn in groups so, if you have a group of friends or co-workers you would love to learn English with, then please do not hesitate to contact me and let's have a chat about the kind of lessons you are looking for. I am open to helping people with zero English skills to advanced students. It would be ideal if the learning goals are the same so that we may tackle one topic at a go together. Please note that these group lessons accommodate a group of 5 to 7 individuals, not more and not less.  I am looking forward to working with you to help you improve your English skills

pro_course_detail.title: Russian for Intermediates / Ruso para estudiantes de nivel intermedio
pro_course_detail.description:
This type of lessons will be suitable for intermediate students who want to practice their reading and listening skills while learning new vocabulary and for more advanced learners, who would like to take their language skills to a higher level. We will practice reading, listening and grammar. I will meticulously prepare a comprehensive document centered around the chosen topic, featuring translations, audio, explanations, and in-depth grammar notes that you can keep.

Este tipo de lecciones será adecuado tanto para estudiantes intermedios que deseen practicar sus habilidades de lectura y escucha mientras aprenden nuevo vocabulario, como para estudiantes más avanzados que quieran llevar sus habilidades lingüísticas a un nivel superior. Practicaremos la lectura, la escucha y la gramática. Prepararé meticulosamente un documento completo centrado en el tema elegido, que incluirá traducciones, audio, explicaciones y notas gramaticales detalladas que podrás conservar.

pro_course_detail.title: Russian Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
This type of lessons will be suitable for more advanced learners, who would like to take their speaking skills to a higher level. We will talk about the topics of your interest and I will provide you with the transcript of the lesson, audio recordings of key phrases, necessary explanations and in-depth grammar notes that you can keep forever.

Bu tür dersler, konuşma becerilerini daha üst bir seviyeye taşımak isteyen daha ileri düzeydeki öğreniciler için uygun olacaktır. İlgi alanlarınıza yönelik konular hakkında konuşacağız ve size dersin transkriptini, anahtar ifadelerin ses kayıtlarını, gerekli açıklamaları ve sonsuza dek saklayabileceğiniz detaylı dilbilgisi notlarını sağlayacağım.

Este tipo de lecciones será adecuado para estudiantes más avanzados que deseen llevar sus habilidades de conversación a un nivel superior. Hablaremos sobre los temas de tu interés, y te proporcionaré la transcripción de la lección, grabaciones de audio de frases clave, las explicaciones necesarias y notas gramaticales detalladas que podrás conservar para siempre.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description: This type of lessons is suitable for those, who wants to practice their speaking abilities and bring them to a whole new level. I will provide audio and text notes after the lesson to boost the acquisition of new vocabulary
